items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: That is something that comes from Chopin.

ctx.x: On the Savoy label, the composition is credited not only to Silver, but to B. F. Wood.
Now the Kirby Band featured a composition called "Opus No. 5," but this is not the tune that resembles "Opus de Funk." That is something that comes from Chopin.
The theme that does resemble it is a Charlie Shavers compositon called "Swedish Schapps." As far as I know, he recorded this also in 1953 for the Clef label with Gene Krupa.
